# seo_geo (Ruby / Rails)

> Rails engine for SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization: visibility in AI search and assistants), not a geolocation gem. One initializer and one layout line give meta tags with canonical folding, JSON-LD from one page-copy source, crawler fallback bodies for Inertia/SPA pages, purpose-based AI crawler policy (training / search / user), per-host robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, Markdown negotiation, IndexNow, OG images and an audit task.

- Install: `gem "seo_geo"` in the Gemfile, then `bin/rails g seo_geo:install https://www.example.com`. Version 0.1.0 is on RubyGems.
- Requirements: Ruby >= 3.2, Rails 7.2 / 8.0 / 8.1 (CI covers every cell). Runtime dependencies: railties, actionpack, meta-tags ~> 2.24, reverse_markdown ~> 3.0. Optional: ferrum (OG cards), ActiveJob (IndexNow job).
- Public API: `SeoGeo.configure`, `SeoGeo.config`, `SeoGeo.sitemap.draw { add ... }`, `SeoGeo.page(:key)`, `SeoGeo.pages.register`; view helpers `seo_geo_head`, `seo_geo_html_lang`, `seo_geo_fallback_body(:key)`, `seo_geo_faq(:key)`; controller `seo(title:, description:, image:, noindex:, index:, canonical:, type:, json_ld:, published_time:, modified_time:)`, `seo_geo_page(:key)`; `include SeoGeo::Markdownable` + `seo_geo_markdown only:, page:`; `SeoGeo::JsonLd`; `SeoGeo::IndexNow.submit(urls)`, model macro `seo_geo_indexnow on: :publish, url:`; `rake seo_geo:audit`; `rails g seo_geo:install`; `require "seo_geo/testing"` (Minitest) and `require "seo_geo/rspec"`; `SeoGeo::BotVerifier::Middleware`; JS `window.SeoGeo.mounted()`.
- Article times: `seo type: "article", published_time:, modified_time:` accepts Time, Date or ISO 8601 strings and emits ISO 8601 `article:published_time` / `article:modified_time`; omitted for other types. Use real stored dates.
- Remote audit: `bundle exec rake seo_geo:audit URL=https://example.com` or `URLS=a,b` (FORMAT=json supported), no app boot; `SeoGeo::Audit::Remote.run(urls, io:)`. Serial Net::HTTP, 0.5s spacing, 10s timeouts, original redirect responses retained with at most five traced hops. Errors for header noindex and incomplete chains; warnings for >1 redirect hop and robots differences when matching config is available. Both modes check soft-404 and duplicate descriptions.
- Routes served when mounted at "/": `GET /robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`, `/<indexnow-key>.txt`, `/og/:key.png`, and `.md` for every Markdownable action.
- Invariants: undeclared hosts fail closed; one copy source per page; the User-Agent is never used for access decisions; no invented lastmod.
- License: MIT.

## Optional

- [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org/): the format this gem generates
- [Which AI actually reads your site (Evil Martians, 2026)](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/which-ai-actually-reads-your-site-two-months-of-llm-traffic-measured): agent traffic measurements behind the "HTML first, Markdown second, llms.txt cheap" design
- [RFC 9309](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9309): Robots Exclusion Protocol, which the robots.txt output follows
- [IndexNow](https://www.indexnow.org/documentation): the protocol behind `SeoGeo::IndexNow`
- [webmcp](https://github.com/seunghan91/webmcp): related gem that lets in-browser agents call your app's endpoints as tools
